about_the_game:
Description

Try 2 Sleep is a casual couch Co-op horror game inspired by paranormal movies. An evil spirit has invaded your house, collaborate with your partner and survive the night terrors!

Are you a good couple? You'll need to work together and be in perfect harmony or you won't survive. Your connection will determine your fate.

The game rules:

  • House issues won't let you sleep. Fix them!

  • Save energy, sleep! Do not blackout or you will be become an easy target. 

  • Repel different enemies, some will try to hurt you bad.

  • Do not let your partner die, you die you lose.

  • Maintain the house well illuminated, with dark comes danger.

  • Check the cameras, catch them before they catch you.

  • Survive the night and fight the final boss together or abandon the house.

What is missing in the Demo?

  • Final boss: search key and open basement puzzle. Fight your enemy!

  • Alternative ending (abandon the house).

  • New items: Syringe and Axe.

  • Doors can get locked.

  • Advanced AI, enemies will be more intelligent.

  • Pillow Fight minigame.

  • Car interaction.

  • TV: Channels and music.

Store Capsules made by Gonzalo Guastavino (whynotstuff.wns)
